context.content_translation:
每位员工必须与管理层协调，以便可以妥善安排_______时间休假。
A. alone
B. individual
C. isolating
D. separated

items.question: Each employee must coordinate with 11 management so that ------- time off can be properly scheduled.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“individual”代入题干后为“Each employee must coordinate with 11 management so that individual time off can be properly scheduled.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（individual）。
